The lattice parameters of the alloy exhibited a gradual reduction from 3.381 Å in Mo0 to 3.353 Å in Mo15 alloy, which indicates that the degree of lattice distortion in Al5Nb(25-x)Ti35Zr35Mox alloys increased as Mo content increased.

evidence.section: 4.2. Strengthening mechanism of Al5Nb(25-x)Ti35Zr35Mox alloys under room temperature
evidence.quote: Mo alloying in Al5Nb(25-x)Ti35Zr35Mox alloys simultaneously promotes two key strengthening mechanisms: grain boundary strengthening through grain size reduction and solid solution strengthening via increased lattice distortion.
